headline: BTC consolidates below 84.8k as altcoins rally on fresh capital inflows
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is forming lower lows but the 4H timeframe still holds above the 83.5k support zone, eyeing the 84.8k resistance as a liquidity pool for potential short squeezes.
altcoin_summary: After BTC’s dip, capital is rotating into altcoins, with top gainers NIL, NOM, SAGA and LSK leading a short‑term rally.
strategy_outlook: Spot: add to positions on dips near 83.5k with stops just below 83k; Futures: stay short or hedge until BTC retests the 84.8k resistance level.
